# Lead sine wave at 440Hz (A4) 0.5 sec
def make_sine(freq, duration=0.5, rate=44100, amp=0.5):
    t = np.arange(int(rate*duration)) / rate
    wave = np.sin(2*np.pi*freq*t) * amp
    # scale to int16 range
    wave_int = np.int16(np.clip(wave, -1, 1) * 32767)
    return wave_int
lead = make_sine(440.0)
# Bass square wave at C2 (65.406 Hz) 0.5 sec
rate=44100
freq=65.406
samples=int(rate*0.5)
t=np.arange(samples)/rate
square = np.sign(np.sin(2*np.pi*freq*t)) * 0.5
square_int = np.int16(np.clip(square, -1, 1) * 32767)
# Drum noise burst 0.1 sec
noise = np.random.uniform(-1,1, int(rate*0.1)) * 0.5
noise_int = np.int16(np.clip(noise, -1, 1) * 32767)
# base64 encode each as little-endian int16
enc = lambda arr: base64.b64encode(arr.tobytes()).decode('ascii')
print('LEAD:', enc(lead))
print('BASS:', enc(square_int))
print('DRUM:', enc(noise_int))
